title: Geller bends a spoon during the film interview

tellings.quote: he did bend a spoon for us when we did the interview and I don't know how he did it.

plain: The spoon-bender Uri Geller bent a spoon in front of a film crew while they interviewed him, according to a researcher named Greg Malatzi, who was there. Malatzi tells Michels simply that Geller 'did bend a spoon for us' and that he does not know how he did it.
